**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

§ 12.3 affirmatively preserves our freedom to build, buy, license, sell and compete in any field or territory, and confirms we have given no non-compete or field-of-use commitment — this meets the preferred position under NONCOMPETE. I checked the rest of the document for restrictions binding us: § 2.1 disclaims any purchase commitment, § 13.4 is ordinary acceptable-use (reverse engineering, security, lawful use) rather than a competitive covenant, and § 24.2 binds Vendor. The § 2.2 sole-and-exclusive-provider term is a supply exclusivity that belongs to the separate exclusivity rule (and is in tension with § 12.3), so I have not double-flagged it here.
